text:
emma (partnerships): Heads up — launching a Rapid SI Certification pilot to speed partner enablement. Goal: certify 6 SIs in 6 weeks. Pilot cohort starts Mon Apr 14. Can we confirm curriculum owners?

josh (solutions): I can own hands-on labs and run day-2 debugging session. Will need infra for 10 concurrent seats.

marta (sales_eng): I'll surface pilot SIs and get NDAs signed. Also need joint MKT comms template.

marcus (training): Agree on learning objectives: install, deploy, performance tuning, rollout patterns, observability. Draft syllabus below:
```
Week 0: Prework + env setup
Week 1: Quickstart + hosted->dedicated migration
Week 2: Performance tuning + caching & batching
Week 3: Private deployment + security
Week 4: Troubleshooting + SLAs
Week 5: Certification lab + exam
```

sam (prod_ops): For the labs, we'll use small dedicated clusters in us-west-2, ephemeral creds. I'll provision by next Tue.

emma (partnerships): Great — can we keep cohort size <=8 for pilot. Marcus, will you create slides + lab guides by Fri?

marcus (training): Yes, aiming for draft by Thu EOD. Need sample model weights and a safe dataset for evals.

josh (solutions): I'll add a dockerized model (quantized) and a tiny eval set. Link to repo: https://git.internal/rw/si-bootcamp

marta (sales_eng): For certifications, propose two tiers: 'Implementer' (deploy + tuning) and 'Integrator' (end-to-end SI solution + runbook). Thoughts?

emma (partnerships): Love tiers. Also need acceptance criteria for each lab. Put them in GH issues and I’ll review.

oncall-bot: Reminder: there is a platform maintenance window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Avoid scheduling lab tasks during that time.

sam (prod_ops): Noted — will avoid. Also need to confirm whether SIs get sandbox API keys or limited production-like tokens.

josh (solutions): Sandbox keys with telemetry enabled. We'll rotate them per cohort.

marta (sales_eng): I'll draft partner comms and ops checklist. Can someone own certification exam grading?

marcus (training): I can coordinate grading automation, but need a small ops budget for manual reviews on edge cases.

emma (partnerships): OK — I'll loop legal and finance. Next sync: Thu 10am PT. Agenda: seats, infra costs, comms, grading SLA.

marta (sales_eng): Adding to calendar. :thumbsup:

josh (solutions): Will finish lab infra playbook before sync.

emma (partnerships): Thanks team — small pilot, quick feedback loop. Let's keep notes in the SI enablement doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/si/rapid-cert
